openPoints: Does the floor regime actually deliver chip-level spatial density when .og-card retains its fixed 280x220 height and width, hiding only markdown while preserving the full card hitbox and layout footprint?

How stable is the 60 FPS result across constrained CI hardware when each animation frame starts an asynchronous React Flow setViewport operation without awaiting or otherwise proving that viewport updates complete before the next sample?

What prevents the one-second countdown state in CellContainers from rebuilding every container and avatar aggregation at large cell counts, and where is that recurring update cost represented in the performance fixture?

How will the single, long semantic-zoom E2E diagnose regressions reliably when markdown safety, collaboration events, exceptional states, turn targeting, and minimap navigation all share mutable setup and one failure can mask the remaining contracts?

Should empty locked cells expose the same actionable turn/collaboration semantics as projected cell headers, rather than appearing in a separate informational aside that cannot participate in normal canvas navigation?
architectureTip: Preserve the CSS-driven single-root model, but make each LOD's geometry explicit and isolate live cell projections and browser contracts so performance and interaction failures remain observable independently.
